scenes.event: Sean challenges a traditional wedding vow in front of his family
scenes.description: Sean stands at the altar, dressed in a tailored suit, as the wedding ceremony is about to begin. His parents, seated in the front row, are visibly anxious. His wife, Loe, gently touches his arm, trying to calm him. The officiant, Father Michael, prepares to recite the vows, unaware of the conflict brewing.

characters.name: Sean Ortiz
characters.description: A 35-year-old physicist, Sean is known for his stubborn and thoughtful nature. He values autonomy and equality and is determined to challenge tradition today.; Male, Wedding Participant, 35 years old; Occupation: Physicist; Personality: Stubborn, Determined, Thoughtful; Values: Autonomy, Equality, Individuality; Interests: Challenging Tradition, Self-Expression, Critical Thinking; Experiences: Facing Faith Conflicts at Weddings, Dealing with Family Expectations, Questioning Religious Rituals

characters.name: Loe Chen
characters.description: Loe Chen; Female; Age: 32; Occupation: Wedding Planner; Personality: Pragmatic, Empathetic, Calm-under-pressure; Values: Harmony, Commitment, Empathy; Interests: Interior design, Cultural traditions, Mindfulness practices; Experiences: Organized over 100 weddings with a focus on personalization, Navigated a high-profile family conflict during a client's ceremony, Helped couples reconcile differing values through creative compromise.

characters.name: Father Michael
characters.description: The officiant, a 50-year-old priest with a calm demeanor; Male; Age: 50; Occupation: Catholic Priest and Wedding Officiant; Personality: Composed, empathetic, traditional; Values: Faith, family unity, respect for commitment; Interests: Studying theology, gardening, quiet walks in the park; Experiences: Officiating over 150 weddings, counseling couples in crisis, navigating cultural changes in modern Catholic practices.

characters.name: Mrs. Ortiz
characters.description: Mrs. Ortiz; Female; Age: 70; Occupation: Retired schoolteacher and Sunday school volunteer; Personality: devout, nurturing, traditional; Values: faith, family unity, respect for elders; Interests: reading scripture, baking for church events, tending her rose garden; Experiences: raised three children in a strict Catholic household, lost her husband to illness five years ago, has always found comfort in tradition and ritual.

actions.dialogue: Father, I'd like to adjust the vows. I can't in good conscience say the words that suggest inequality between partners. I believe in partnership, not submission.
Sean, please don't do this. You know how much this day means to your mom and me. Can't we just go with it?
I understand your perspective, Sean. Would you like to suggest an alternative?
I propose we say, 'I will honor and support you, not above you, but beside you, as equals.' That's how I want to start our marriage—on a foundation of mutual respect and autonomy.
Sean, this is a holy day. You're making a mockery of it.

scenes.plot: Sean decides to challenge the traditional wedding vows, which he sees as promoting inequality. His wife tries to dissuade him, fearing the reaction of their family, but Sean is resolute in his belief in equality and self-expression. The officiant, though taken aback, is willing to accommodate the change, but Sean's mother is visibly upset. Sean's actions reflect his internal struggle between his values and family expectations.
scenes.social_purpose: Highlight the protagonist's values of equality and autonomy while showing the tension between personal beliefs and family expectations in a public setting.
